blockingFindings.description: Direct inspection of all current five views and six pose renders confirms the skirt remains visibly faceted, with irregular pleats, layered/lifting panels, and an uneven hem. V180 reduces lower front-lap circumferential curvature by 20 percent toward the chord, with measured maximum displacement 7.10 mm and zero shared-seam displacement. The diagnostic union changes from V179 80/532 to 69/532 crouch and 21/532 to 18/532 sit, but same-side sit near-distance counts remain 1/266 on each side, with no improvement; front/side panels still open around the legs in crouch and sit. This is a prototype geometry diagnostic, not fit acceptance.

Gray body-colored-looking patches and hard facets remain across the ivory chest and waist in the current front and posed renders. Their cause is not established by the renders. The visible bodice surface quality remains unacceptable and is a separate blocker from the skirt geometry.

outOfScope: VRChat Build & Test and runtime inspection
